sources.title: NRF forecasts 2026 holiday sales growth as consumers remain resilient
Affordability shapes winter holiday shopping, according to NRF holiday survey
US retail trade group forecasts healthy holiday sales, in part due to inflation

scenes.title: $1 trillion holidays

lines.say: Americans are expected to spend more than one trillion dollars this holiday season.
